request.style: English, Female solo voice, warm and intimate, acoustic guitar, piano, cello, soft drums, hopeful and gentle, 75 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
I sought the Lord and he answered me
He delivered me from all my fears
My soul boasts in the Lord today
Let the humble hear and rejoice

[Chorus]
Magnify the Lord with me
Let us exalt his name together
I sought the Lord and he answered me
Delivered me from all my fears

[Verse]
Those who look to him are radiant
Their faces will never be ashamed
This poor man called and the Lord heard
He saved him out of all his troubles

[Chorus]
Magnify the Lord with me
Let us exalt his name together
I sought the Lord and he answered me
Delivered me from all my fears

[Bridge]
The angel of the Lord encamps around
Those who fear him he rescues
His praise will always be on my lips
I will bless the Lord at all times

[Outro]
I sought the Lord and he answered me
He delivered me from all my fears
